name: price_check
description: Fetch a product page right now and report its price, currency and title, plus the change against the last price stored for that URL. Does not create a watch.

name: watch_add
description: Start tracking a product page. Fetches it once and stores the first observation. Optionally set a target price to be alerted about.

arguments.name: target_price
arguments.desc: Alert when the price is at or below this (positive number)

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: ISO code such as USD or EUR, if the page does not say

name: watch_list
description: Show every tracked item with its current price, target and last check time.

name: watch_remove
description: Stop tracking an item, by watch id or by URL. Its history is deleted.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: URL of the watch, if you do not have the id

name: watch_refresh
description: Re-fetch one watch or every watch, append the new observations and show current, previous, min, max, change % and target hits.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Watch id or URL. Omit and set all=true to refresh everything.

name: price_history
description: List the stored observations for one watch, newest last. Free shows the last 10.

name: price_add_manual
description: Store a price you read yourself, for shops that block automated requests. Creates the watch if it does not exist yet.

arguments.name: price
arguments.desc: Price as shown, for example 1299.00 or 1.299,00

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: ISO code such as USD or EUR

name: alerts_pending
description: Show watches whose latest price is at or below the target, or which dropped 5% or more against the previous observation.

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
